correctness.rationale: Expanded M_theta^*M_theta exactly for cyclic S_we_j=w_je_{j+1}, using unnormalized trace((M*M)^2). Obtains A sum x_j^2 + B sum x_j x_(j+1) +2B sqrt(product x_j) cos(4theta), A=t^4+(1-t)^4, B=4t^2(1-t)^2; supremum sets cos(4theta)=1. Opposite-parity aggregate variables u=x0+x2,v=1-u,p=sqrt(x0x2),q=sqrt(x1x3) give F=A(u^2+v^2-2p^2-2q^2)+Buv+2Bpq. For beta<2, Hessian in p,q has eigenvalues -4A±2B<0, so every minimizer is a rectangle corner. Corner options: both parity pairs balanced gives U=A/4+3B/8 when beta<=2/3; one balanced gives R=A-(2A-B)^2/(6A-4B) for beta<1; neither balanced never beats A/2. Exact differences R-U= -A*(beta-2)*(2beta-1)/(8*(2beta-3)), R-A/2=A*(beta-1)^2/[2(2beta-3)] cross at beta=1/2,1. At beta=2, F/A=1-2(p-q)^2 and |p-q|<=1/2 forces opposite pair only; beta->t thresholds from 4z^2/(1+z^4), z=t/(1-t). Independently verified 243 exact rational 4x4 Gram trace cases, plus symbolic branch algebra; finite testing is not a proof of all t,w, which follows from Hessian/corner analysis. Strict positivity excludes beta>1/2 minimizers but preserves same infimum.
